what_this_is: Toolbar controls on the operational screens that have no Actions menu, split into domain verbs and the grid chrome every screen shares.
method: Buttons were read from the component tree. Nothing was clicked.
finding: Most of these screens are monitors, not action surfaces: they carry only export, print, refresh and filter. The operational write surface is concentrated in the 40 screens that DO have an Actions menu.
screens_that_are_monitors_only: Items Not Assigned To A Location
